newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: New investment trust launched for Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: New investment trust launched for Zimbabwe.

text.p: A new investment trust has been launched in Zimbabwe, bringing to just over half a dozen the number of investment trusts operating in the southern African state.

Steve Margolis, chairman of the new Africa Investment Trust (AIT), said at the launch late on Tuesday that individual and corporate investors could buy units at a start-off value of Z$100 (U.S.$10.95) each.

The Africa Investment Trust fund will be managed by Zimbabwe's Merchant Bank of Central Africa, and the money will be invested in land, housing, industrial and warehouses, equity, joint venture projects and acquisitions, he said.
